originality.rationale: The closest directly related published theorem covers only two axes of groups of order >=5; order four was explicitly left unresolved. The new q=4 proof overcomes the reversed mixed-energy sign and the all-dimension conclusion is not implied by an unchanged restriction to two axes. Searches found no dominating statement, although a broader product-space theorem remains a plausible historical risk.
